text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a research article focused on species distribution modeling of rubber tree cultivation suitability under climate change scenarios in two regions of India. The primary focus is on predicting suitable areas for rubber tree plantations based on climatic variables, not on land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. The paper does not implement multiple future LULC scenarios with quantitative comparison, nor does it produce mapped LULC projections. It does not meet the core inclusion criteria for national-scale LULC prediction studies and is species-specific/ecological in focus. Therefore, it fails inclusion criteria and meets exclusion criteria related to species-specific ecological focus unrelated to LULC.)
